evidence.observation: H701 heater temperature reads 408.569 °C, far above the other reboiler heater and vessel.
T701 has risen to 416.937 °C while T702 is 76.370 °C and T703 is 66.612 °C; the extreme discrepancy persists.
System pressure is 450.270 mbar and pressure differences are 0.349 and 2.360 mbar, without a sustained pressure rise corroborating a blockage.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater setpoint/power and sensor diagnostics are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a temperature-sensor fault; composition measurement and separation target are needed to assess separation.
